        return g

    vertical_down = any(g[r][cc] == guide for r in range(cr + 1, h))
    tr = -1 if vertical_down else 1
    tc = -1 if horizontal_right else 1

            if all((y-cr)*tr > 0 and (x-cc)*tc > 0 for y, x in comp):
                for y, x in comp:

    return g
